newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via 10-day fixed system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via 10-day fixed system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves into the banking system via 10-day fixed system repurchase agreements Monday, a New York spokesman said.
The Fed's operation was generally expected.
Analysts said the 10-day RPs addresses the add need for the rest of the maintenance period, although additional RPs may be needed next week.
Also, a coupon pass -- which adds permanent reserves -- is still expected after Thanksgiving.
